_about: (polish1 item 58) The colosseum's ROTATING BANNER TICKETS (core/colosseum_rules.gd banners; drafted by me, the director's to rewrite). Every `minutes` minutes of real-world (UTC) time two of these are on the board, the same two for everyone (picked from the clock, nothing sent online). A banner = a ticket of `waves` waves with its modifiers ticked (more may be added) and a boost: maker (most guns from that maker, `share` of them, default 0.7), body (most guns of that kind), luck (every drop chance x), armour (armour drop chance x), treasure (Phoon's Treasure chance x), chest_guns (more guns in the end chest), pony (the last boss's pony weight x). title / icon (a shape of data/icons.json) / color / line are what the board shows.

banners.title: Kestrel Week
banners.line: Kestrel Works guns everywhere: most drops come from their benches.

banners.title: The Brawn Brawl
banners.line: Brawn & Sons send their heavy iron, and the arena hits back hard.

banners.title: Zephyr Gale
banners.line: A short, fast run; Zephyr Labs guns ride the wind in.

banners.title: Moss Bloom
banners.line: The sand turns sour, and Moss Dynamics guns sprout from it.

banners.title: Vantor Siege
banners.line: Twelve waves of tough hides; Vantor Ordnance pays for every one.

banners.title: Halyard High Tide
banners.line: A packed house at high tide, and Halyard Marine guns wash in with it.

banners.title: Cinderwright Forge
banners.line: Enemies burst where they fall; the Foundry's guns come out of the fire.

banners.title: Lumen's Eye
banners.line: Fog over the sand, and Lumen Optics guns to see through it.

banners.title: Sniper Season
banners.line: Heavy feet, long barrels: mostly sniper rifles drop.

banners.title: Shotgun Wedding
banners.line: Close quarters, crowded house, double barrels for everyone.

banners.title: Rocket Day
banners.line: Two bosses a boss wave, and rocket launchers to answer them.

banners.title: Bullet Hose
banners.line: Fast feet, fast guns: submachine guns rain down.

banners.title: High Noon
banners.line: One life to live and a revolver to live it with.

banners.title: Frontier Rifles
banners.line: The ring closes in; lever rifles keep it honest.

banners.title: Harpoon Hunt
banners.line: Berserkers charge, harpoon guns pin them down.

banners.title: Flame Festival
banners.line: A short fuse and a long flame: flamethrowers for all.

banners.title: Crossbow Court
banners.line: Slow hands, quiet bolts: mostly crossbows drop.

banners.title: Blunderbuss Bash
banners.line: They hit hard, you hit harder: blunderbusses galore.

banners.title: Lucky Hour
banners.line: No tricks, just luck: every drop chance is up by more than half.

banners.title: The Glass Gamble
banners.line: Half health, one life, double luck. Feeling brave?

banners.title: Elite Parade
banners.line: Every enemy an elite, all twelve waves long, and luck to match.

banners.title: Boss Rush
banners.line: Twin bosses that only fear headshots; a fuller chest at the end.

banners.title: Armour Fair
banners.line: Armour drops three times as often.

banners.title: Phoon's Hoard
banners.line: No breather between waves, but Phoon's Treasure is three times as likely.

banners.title: Pony Pilgrimage
banners.line: Twelve waves among vampires; the last boss's pony chance is doubled.

banners.title: Lights Out
banners.line: Fight in the dark for half again the luck.

banners.title: Iron Rations
banners.line: Half the ammo going in, one more gun in the chest coming out.

banners.title: The Long Haul
banners.line: Twelve waves without a breath: better luck and a fuller chest.

banners.title: Hardcore Hour
banners.line: One life, half health, heavy hits. Two and a half times the luck.

banners.title: Mixed Bag
banners.line: A bit of everything: quicker, tougher enemies, a bit more of every drop.
